dialogues.jp: 穏やかな春の日差し。
dialogues.en: It was a nice spring day.
dialogues.text: It was a nice spring day.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりでどこかに出かけようと訪れた公園で、
音夢と歩きながらぼーっ、と鳩を見つめる。
dialogues.en: I stared at a pigeon as I walked in the park with Nemu.
dialogues.text: I stared at a pigeon as I walked in the park with Nemu.

dialogues.jp: そして追いかけたくなる。
dialogues.en: And it made me want to chase them.
dialogues.text: And it made me want to chase them.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「くすくす……」
dialogues.en: "Teehee......"
dialogues.text: "Teehee......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、なんかね……こぅ、恋人同士に見える
　かなって考えたら――」
dialogues.en: "Well, I was just wondering if we look like a couple."
dialogues.text: "Well, I was just wondering if we look like a couple."

dialogues.jp: 前を歩いていた音夢が振り返る。
dialogues.en: Nemu was walking ahead and she turned around.
dialogues.text: Nemu was walking ahead and she turned around.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Ah-huh."
dialogues.text: "Ah-huh."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「――そうは見えないだろうなって」
dialogues.en: "But, I guess not."
dialogues.text: "But, I guess not."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おぃ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: 思わず肩を落としてしまう。
dialogues.en: That made me disappointed.
dialogues.text: That made me disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、なんかいつも通りなんだもん」
dialogues.en: "Because everything's still the same."
dialogues.text: "Because everything's still the same."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いつも通りって、そりゃそうだろう。デート
　じゃなくてお前のリハビリみたいなもんなん
　だから」
dialogues.en:
"Off course it is. This isn't a date, but rather
rehabilitation for you."
dialogues.text:
"Off course it is. This isn't a date, but rather
rehabilitation for you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだけどさぁ……こう、あるでしょ、色々
　と思うところが」
dialogues.en: "I know...... but you know... I have a lot on my mind."
dialogues.text: "I know...... but you know... I have a lot on my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「思うところねぇ」
dialogues.en: "A lot on your mind?"
dialogues.text: "A lot on your mind?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず苦笑いを浮かべながら、そっと手を差し
出す。
dialogues.en: I smiled and reached my hand out to her.
dialogues.text: I smiled and reached my hand out to her.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ今日は、映画感覚で行きますかお姫
　様？」
dialogues.en: "Then, would you like to make it like a movie, my princess?"
dialogues.text: "Then, would you like to make it like a movie, my princess?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……それなら違うよ。兄さん」
dialogues.en: "That's not how it goes."
dialogues.text: "That's not how it goes."

dialogues.jp: 音夢は手を｛つか／掴｝まず、そっと身を寄せる。
dialogues.en: Nemu didn't take my hand, but she came closer to me.
dialogues.text: Nemu didn't take my hand, but she came closer to me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「腕組みくらいしてくれないと」
dialogues.en: "We have to walk arm in arm."
dialogues.text: "We have to walk arm in arm."

dialogues.jp: 腕を絡めて、音夢が真っ赤な顔で俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu took my arm and looked up to me with a red face in
embarrassment.
dialogues.text:
Nemu took my arm and looked up to me with a red face in
embarrassment.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おぃ……これはさすがに……」
dialogues.en: "H-Hey...... We have to do this?"
dialogues.text: "H-Hey...... We have to do this?"

dialogues.jp: ただでさえ、最近は周囲の視線が気になるのに。
dialogues.en:
I care about how people look at us in normal circumstances.
This seems a bit too much.
dialogues.text:
I care about how people look at us in normal circumstances.
This seems a bit too much.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「恥ずかしいのは我慢です」
dialogues.en: "You have to get over it."
dialogues.text: "You have to get over it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「真っ赤な顔のまま言うなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't talk with your cheeks blushed like that."
dialogues.text: "Don't talk with your cheeks blushed like that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Heehee."
dialogues.text: "Heehee."

dialogues.jp:
恥ずかしいのだろうが、音夢はぎゅっ、と強く
俺の腕に抱きつく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu held onto my arm so tight even though she seemed to be
embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
Nemu held onto my arm so tight even though she seemed to be
embarrassed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……これで、どこからどうみても恋人
　でしょ♪」
dialogues.en: "Niisan... See? Don't we look like a couple now?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan... See? Don't we look like a couple now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃな」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp:
思わずゆるみそうになる表情を、どうにか普段
通りにたもつ。
dialogues.en: I try to keep a normal face even though it was difficult.
dialogues.text: I try to keep a normal face even though it was difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、まだそんなこと言ってる！」
dialogues.en: "You said it again!"
dialogues.text: "You said it again!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Whatever."
dialogues.text: "Whatever."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「恥ずかしくて仕方ないくせにぃ」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you embarrassed?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you embarrassed?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前が言うな、お前が！　頬がゆるみっぱな
　しでだらしない顔のくせに」
dialogues.en: "Don't say that. You look quite embarrassed as well."
dialogues.text: "Don't say that. You look quite embarrassed as well."

dialogues.jp: 真っ赤になった頬を指で押す。
dialogues.en: I pushed her red cheek with my finger.
dialogues.text: I pushed her red cheek with my finger.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だって……仕方ないじゃない！」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I can't help it."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I can't help it."

dialogues.jp:
ぷぃ、と顔を逸らした音夢だが、すぐに顔がに
やける。
dialogues.en: Nemu looked away, but couldn't stop smiling.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked away, but couldn't stop smiling.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あははは……駄目、勝手に顔が……」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god...... I can't keep a straight face."
dialogues.text: "Oh my god...... I can't keep a straight face."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「子供かお前は」
dialogues.en: "What a child you are."
dialogues.text: "What a child you are."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ね、兄さんも嬉しいでしょ？　幸せだよねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you happy too? I'm so happy."
dialogues.text: "Aren't you happy too? I'm so happy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「知るか」
dialogues.en: "I don't know."
dialogues.text: "I don't know."

dialogues.jp: にらめっこに負けそうなので顔を逸らす。
dialogues.en: I looked away trying to keep my face straight.
dialogues.text: I looked away trying to keep my face straight.

dialogues.jp: 本当に穏やかな日だ。
dialogues.en: Such a calm nice day.
dialogues.text: Such a calm nice day.

dialogues.jp:
風が桜の枝を揺らし、さわさわ、と桜が舞い散
る。
dialogues.en:
The wind blowing the cherry blossom trees and shaking their
branches, making the petals fall all over the place.
dialogues.text:
The wind blowing the cherry blossom trees and shaking their
branches, making the petals fall all over the place.

dialogues.jp: 子供達の嬌声と、どこか遠くで犬が鳴く声。
dialogues.en: I could hear kids playing and a dog barking somewhere.
dialogues.text: I could hear kids playing and a dog barking somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……春だよ兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Spring has come, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Spring has come, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「春だな」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.jp: 音夢とふたり、思わず空を見上げてしまう。
dialogues.en: We looked up on the sky together.
dialogues.text: We looked up on the sky together.

dialogues.jp: 「公園なんかで良かったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is this what you wanted to do?"
dialogues.text: "Is this what you wanted to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほぇ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「デート。公園なんかでよかったのか？」
dialogues.en: "The date. Is the park okay?"
dialogues.text: "The date. Is the park okay?"

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、音夢が目を細めて頷く。
dialogues.en: Nemu narrowed her eyes and nodded to my question.
dialogues.text: Nemu narrowed her eyes and nodded to my question.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん……まだ体調が良くないから、人ごみよ
　りはこっちのほうがいいな」
dialogues.en:
"I don't feel well yet, so it's better to be here than some
other crowded places."
dialogues.text:
"I don't feel well yet, so it's better to be here than some
other crowded places."

dialogues.jp: そして顔を上げた。
dialogues.en: And she looked up.
dialogues.text: And she looked up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、兄さんとふたりきりでいられれば、私
　はどこでも、どこまでも幸せだから！」
dialogues.en:
"But I'm happy if I can stay with you no matter where I end
up."
dialogues.text:
"But I'm happy if I can stay with you no matter where I end
up."

dialogues.jp: 固めていた表情のネジがはずれる。
dialogues.en: I couldn't keep the straight face any more.
dialogues.text: I couldn't keep the straight face any more.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ば――なんです？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「馬鹿は俺だ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm stupid......"
dialogues.text: "I'm stupid......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは♪　そうです。おかしいのは兄さ
　んです」
dialogues.en: "What? Sure, you're stupid."
dialogues.text: "What? Sure, you're stupid."

dialogues.jp:
身体を回して、俺の正面に立って音夢が背伸び
する。
dialogues.en: Nemu came around in front of me, and stood up on her toes.
dialogues.text: Nemu came around in front of me, and stood up on her toes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと一緒だよ兄さん」
dialogues.en: "I won't let you go."
dialogues.text: "I won't let you go."

dialogues.jp: 人前だってことはある――。
dialogues.en: Yes, we're in public.
dialogues.text: Yes, we're in public.

dialogues.jp:
だけど、周りにいるのは子供とその母親とお年
寄り、そして美春とことりくらいで……。
dialogues.en:
But, all I can see are kids and their mothers and some old
people and Miharu and Kotori......
dialogues.text:
But, all I can see are kids and their mothers and some old
people and Miharu and Kotori......

dialogues.en: "Shit!"
dialogues.text: "Shit!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Oh my..."
dialogues.text: "Oh my..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぅ♪」
dialogues.en: "Wow."
dialogues.text: "Wow."

dialogues.jp: 四者四様の声を上げて、全員が動きを止める。
dialogues.en: All four of us raised our voices and stopped moving.
dialogues.text: All four of us raised our voices and stopped moving.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の肩越しに立っていたふたり。
dialogues.en: I found two of them standing behind Nemu.
dialogues.text: I found two of them standing behind Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ぅわ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh my..."
dialogues.text: "Oh my..."

dialogues.jp:
遅れて振り向いた音夢も、俺の肩に手をおいた
まま硬直した。
dialogues.en:
Nemu turned around to look, and she froze with her hands
still on my shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Nemu turned around to look, and she froze with her hands
still on my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その、これは、天枷さんとチョコバナ
　ナの美味しい公園に屋台を食べに来て……
　あれ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah... well... We came to buy chocolate bananas from the
stand in the park, and then... umm..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah... well... We came to buy chocolate bananas from the
stand in the park, and then... umm..."

dialogues.jp: ことりが帽子をいじくりながら呟く。
dialogues.en: Kotori mumbled, touching her hat.
dialogues.text: Kotori mumbled, touching her hat.

dialogues.jp: 滅茶苦茶だが、状況だけは分かるな。
dialogues.en: She sounds confused, but I see why they're here.
dialogues.text: She sounds confused, but I see why they're here.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうなんですよ朝倉先輩！　もぅ、美春
　達のことなんてなかったことにして、続きを
　どうぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"That's right, Asakura-sempai. Please don't mind us, keep on
doing what you were going to do."
dialogues.text:
"That's right, Asakura-sempai. Please don't mind us, keep on
doing what you were going to do."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もうこうやってグッと熱く！」
dialogues.en: "Yes, go on and kiss!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, go on and kiss!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……楽しそうだな美春」
dialogues.en: "Don't you sound happy, Miharu......"
dialogues.text: "Don't you sound happy, Miharu......"

dialogues.jp: 取り｛つくろ／繕｝うのも面倒になってきた。
dialogues.en: I'm so tired of making excuses now.
dialogues.text: I'm so tired of making excuses now.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その……私達はなにも見なかったという
　ことで」
dialogues.en: "Um... We didn't see anything."
dialogues.text: "Um... We didn't see anything."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですよ！　もぅ、音夢先輩との禁断の関
　係なんて、美春はこれっっっ――ぽっちも見
　てませ……もごもご！」
dialogues.en:
"That's right! We didn't see your forbidden relationship
with your brother, Nemu-sempai. Yep!"
dialogues.text:
"That's right! We didn't see your forbidden relationship
with your brother, Nemu-sempai. Yep!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あははは……それじゃあふたりとも」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha...... Goodbye, you two."
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha...... Goodbye, you two."

dialogues.jp:
美春の口を押さえて、ことりが苦笑いを浮かべ
ながら去っていく。
dialogues.en:
Kotori had a wry smile on her face and she placed her hand
over Miharu's mouth and they left.
dialogues.text:
Kotori had a wry smile on her face and she placed her hand
over Miharu's mouth and they left.

dialogues.jp: 「……ちゃんと恋人に見られたぞ」
dialogues.en: "I guess they thought we were a couple."
dialogues.text: "I guess they thought we were a couple."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そ、そうだね」
胸を押さえて、音夢が俺の身体に手をつく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu touched me with her hand, placing her other hand over
her chest.
dialogues.text:
Nemu touched me with her hand, placing her other hand over
her chest.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「き、緊張した〜」
dialogues.en: "It made me so nervous......"
dialogues.text: "It made me so nervous......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はははは」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha."
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の頭に手をおいてぐりぐりとなでる。
dialogues.en: I put my hand over her head and rubbed it.
dialogues.text: I put my hand over her head and rubbed it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うわわわ！　だって見られたんだよ！　見ら
　れちゃったんだよ！　どうしよう！？」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god! They saw us! What should we do?"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god! They saw us! What should we do?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな……」

ふと振り返ると、当たり前だがことりも美春も、
こちらのことをまだ気にしているようだった。
dialogues.en:
I turned around and I noticed Miharu and Kotori were still
looking at us, wondering what was going on.
dialogues.text:
I turned around and I noticed Miharu and Kotori were still
looking at us, wondering what was going on.

dialogues.jp: 「こうするしかないんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "I guess we should do this then."
dialogues.text: "I guess we should do this then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どう――ん」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢を抱き寄せてキスをする。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her and kissed Nemu.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her and kissed Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
最初は抵抗していた音夢も、すぐに大人しくな
る。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was trying to resist it, but then she calmed down soon
enough.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was trying to resist it, but then she calmed down soon
enough.

dialogues.jp:
膝の力でも抜けたのか、ふらふらと音夢が寄り
かかってきた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu leaned over to me as she wasn't able to stand up by
herself.
dialogues.text:
Nemu leaned over to me as she wasn't able to stand up by
herself.

dialogues.en: "See?"
dialogues.text: "See?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……もぅ……馬鹿なんだから」
dialogues.en: "You're such an idiot."
dialogues.text: "You're such an idiot."

dialogues.jp:
胸の中での呟きに笑いながら、遠くで｛あぜん／唖然｝とし
ている美春とことりにニコリと笑ってやった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu mumbled in my arms and I smiled at Miharu and Kotori,
who were looking shocked in the distance.
dialogues.text:
Nemu mumbled in my arms and I smiled at Miharu and Kotori,
who were looking shocked in the distance.

dialogues.jp: ◆公園でのキス◆
dialogues.en: ◆The kiss at the park◆
dialogues.text: ◆The kiss at the park◆

dialogues.jp:
桜公園で音夢と腕を組みデートをしているさな
か、美春とことりに出会う。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and I were on a date at Sakura Park walking arm in arm
when Miharu and Kotori bumped into us.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and I were on a date at Sakura Park walking arm in arm
when Miharu and Kotori bumped into us.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも驚きつつも見逃してくれたが、やっ
ぱり遠くから俺たちのことを気にしている。
dialogues.en:
They looked surprised but they left us alone, but they were
still watching us from distance.
dialogues.text:
They looked surprised but they left us alone, but they were
still watching us from distance.

dialogues.jp: そのふたりの前で、音夢を抱き寄せキスをした。
dialogues.en: I grabbed Nemu and kissed her in front of them.
dialogues.text: I grabbed Nemu and kissed her in front of them.
